name: bmkg_weather_forecasting
description: This project implements two different database schemas (Snowflake and Starflake) for storing BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika) weather forecasting data.

scripts.create:starflake: (psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE bmkg_forecasting_starflake;') || true && psql -U admin -d bmkg_forecasting_starflake -f db/bmkg_forecasting_starflake.sql
scripts.create:snowflake: (psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE bmkg_forecasting_snowflake;') || true && psql -U admin -d bmkg_forecasting_snowflake -f db/bmkg_forecasting_snowflake.sql
scripts.create:logging: (psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE bmkg_error_logging;') || true && psql -U admin -d bmkg_error_logging -f db/bmkg_error_logging.sql
scripts.seed:all:starflake: npm run generate-seeders:starflake && npm run seed:starflake
scripts.seed:all:snowflake: npm run generate-seeders:snowflake && npm run seed:snowflake
scripts.seed:all:bandung:starflake: npm run generate-seeders:bandung:starflake && npm run seed:bandung:starflake
scripts.seed:all:bandung:snowflake: npm run generate-seeders:bandung:snowflake && npm run seed:bandung:snowflake
scripts.get-all-data: npm run get-locations && npm run get-weather
scripts.drop:snowflake: psql -U admin -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'bmkg_forecasting_snowflake';" && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS bmkg_forecasting_snowflake;'
scripts.drop:starflake: psql -U admin -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'bmkg_forecasting_starflake';" && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS bmkg_forecasting_starflake;'
scripts.drop:all: psql -U admin -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname IN ('bmkg_forecasting_starflake', 'bmkg_forecasting_snowflake', 'bmkg_error_logging');" && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS bmkg_forecasting_starflake;' && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS bmkg_forecasting_snowflake;' && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS bmkg_error_logging;'
scripts.create:all: npm run drop:all && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE bmkg_forecasting_starflake;' && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE bmkg_forecasting_snowflake;' && psql -U admin -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE bmkg_error_logging;' && npm run create:starflake && npm run create:snowflake && npm run create:logging
scripts.drop:logging: psql -U admin -d bmkg_error_logging -c 'DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS logging CASCADE;'
scripts.reset:logging: npm run drop:logging && npm run create:logging
